Dr. Reckeweg's Damia-Gold Drops
Sexual and nervous exhaustion drops

Damia-Gold is the latest product from Dr. Reckeweg and extremely beneficial in cases of sexual weakness, low desire and consequent general weakness. As cases of sexual weakness and lack of desire are increasing everyday due to increased pressure of modem day life, stress and side effects of various medications.
Dr. Reckeweg’s Damia Gold is a balanced formula of well known Homoeopathic Ingredients which has a stimulant effect on the sexual organs, without side effects.
 
Brief Indications of The Formula as under:
Acid Phos       : General weakness with impotency specially in diabetic patients.
Agnus Castus : Lack of sexual desire, forgetful & mental depression.
Caladium        : Impotency with no desire, Spermatorrhoea, no erection on effort.
Damiana         : Sexual neurasthenia, useful in old cases, revitalization of sexual  organs.
Muira Puama  :Absence or low sperm count sexual weakness, deficient sexual power.
Nuphar Luteum : Absence of sexual desire, no erection, involuntary emission, testicles painful, organ size reduced.
Ginseng            : Stimulates physical & mental activity, enhances performance & has a stimulating effect on the sexual glands.
 
Dosage : 3 times daily, 10-15 drops in some water.
Composition : Acidum Phosphoricum D6, Agnus Castus D2, Caladium Seguinum D1, Damiana D1, Muira Puama D1, Nuphar Luteum D2, Panax Ginseng D1
